arStrings.szText:
Increases your {c_important}Enchantment{/c} Potency by {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|+%|]{/c}. 

If your equipped {c_important}Enchantments{/c} are different elements, deal {c_number}[({SF_2}+{SF_1}) * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage with their elements. Matching {c_important}Enchantments{/c} elements grant {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage with their element.
